_meta.dataset_name: Greek Insurance Market — Insurer Reference Dataset
_meta.important_caveat: This is a research draft, NOT an authoritative registry. Values tagged 'verified_2026' for call_center, contact_email and hq_address were confirmed against the Bank of Greece register of (re)insurance undertakings on 2026-07-30. Values still tagged 'unverified' or 'stale' must be re-checked before operational use; note the register does NOT cover roadside_assistance_provider or payment_gateway_url, so those cannot be verified from it. The authoritative sources are the Bank of Greece (Τράπεζα της Ελλάδος) private insurance supervision registry and the EAEE (Ένωση Ασφαλιστικών Εταιριών Ελλάδος) member list.
_meta.market_size_note: Greece does not have 100 insurers. Greek-domiciled licensed insurance undertakings number roughly 35-40; the EAEE has ~45 members representing >95% of premiums. Beyond that there are ~90+ EEA insurers operating via Freedom of Services (ΕΠΥ) or branch, most of which are shells represented by a local claims agent and have no Greek call centre, payment gateway or roadside partner. Any list of '100 Greek insurers' would be padded with those.
known_data_gaps: payment_gateway_url: most insurers route card payments through bank-hosted gateways (Eurobank LivePay, Piraeus winbank easypay/Paycenter, Alpha, NBG) or through an authenticated customer portal with no stable public URL. Where a public URL exists it is given; several were last published 2016-2024 and are marked stale.

roadside_assistance_provider: a commercial contract, retendered every few years and rarely announced. The Bank of Greece register can confirm whether a named provider is still licensed to operate in Greece (see assistance_providers), but it CANNOT confirm which insurer contracts whom — that needs the insurer directly. As of 2026-07-30 the six insurers previously recorded as Europ Assistance clients are flagged unverified, because that provider has ceased.

logo_url: deliberately omitted. Insurer logos are trademarked assets served from CDN paths that change without notice; scraping them produces links that rot and creates an IP question. Recommend sourcing logos directly from each insurer's press/brand kit.
name_en: many Greek insurers have no registered English trading name. Where none exists, a transliteration is given and flagged.

recommended_authoritative_sources.source: Τράπεζα της Ελλάδος — Διεύθυνση Εποπτείας Ιδιωτικής Ασφάλισης
recommended_authoritative_sources.why: The legally authoritative register of licensed undertakings, branches and Freedom of Services notifications. Definitive for legal name, licence status and permitted classes (κλάδοι) under Ν.4364/2016 — which is the correct backbone for a lines_of_business field, rather than marketing copy.

recommended_authoritative_sources.source: ΕΑΕΕ (Ένωση Ασφαλιστικών Εταιριών Ελλάδος) member list and Annual Statistical Report
recommended_authoritative_sources.why: Member roster with standardised contact details plus GWP by class, which gives you a defensible ranking rather than a directory ordering.

recommended_authoritative_sources.source: Επικουρικό Κεφάλαιο Ασφάλισης Ευθύνης από Ατυχήματα Αυτοκινήτων
recommended_authoritative_sources.why: Membership is mandatory for any insurer writing Greek motor. The best single filter for 'who actually writes motor here', and therefore for which records genuinely need a roadside_assistance_provider value.
Its ~94 members include the EEA insurers operating via ΕΠΥ with their local claims representatives — the right source if you do want to extend the dataset past the Greek-domiciled undertakings.

recommended_authoritative_sources.source: Each insurer's Solvency and Financial Condition Report (SFCR)
recommended_authoritative_sources.why: Published annually, states the registered seat and the classes actually written. Slower to collect but the only way to get lines_of_business right at scale.
